description: Scaffold of the Plaid app emulator: it launches as --port=N, answers GET /admin/health with {"status":"ok"}, and serves the shared admin plane (reset, state, config, quirks). Sandbox public token creation, public token exchange (Item and access token creation), Item reads (item/get), account and balance reads (accounts/get, accounts/balance/get), account and routing numbers (auth/get, for the checking account only), transaction sync (transactions/sync; every row is available at once and the update status is always HISTORICAL_UPDATE_COMPLETE; no route creates transactions yet), processor tokens for partners and a Stripe bank account token (processor/token/create, processor/stripe/bank_account_token/create; the Stripe app emulator does not yet accept the token), identity and identity match (identity/get, identity/match; match scores use the emulator's own rule inside Plaid's documented score bands), Item removal and access token rotation (item/remove, item/access_token/invalidate), Item error simulation (the documented error_{CODE} Sandbox passwords and sandbox/item/reset_login), the webhook verification key (webhook_verification_key/get), webhook URL updates with signed delivery (item/webhook/update), Sandbox test webhooks (sandbox/item/fire_webhook, the documented codes that have a published sample body), institutions (institutions/get, institutions/search, institutions/get_by_id) and Link token creation and reads (link/token/create, link/token/get) are served. A new Item starts with three default accounts taken from the sample response in Plaid's public docs, a provisional fixture to be replaced once the Sandbox default set is captured, and two transactions on the checking account from Plaid's /transactions/get example, re-dated to end yesterday (the store keeps them with a per-Item change log, and transactions/sync is the only transaction route served). The 22 institutions are Plaid's published Sandbox list plus published sample rows, also provisional: products are a template and routing numbers are mostly not published; the remaining Plaid API routes arrive in later slices of build plan plaid-bp1.
